initial_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE small art-direction prototype image: a SINGLE rectangular pale ivory architectural wall, viewed straight-on with near-orthographic perspective. Landscape 16:9 image. The wall measures approximately 12 metres wide by 7 metres high and almost fills the image, with a slim visible top cap, a thin pale floor strip and a quiet pale blue-gray background margin. No other buildings, no characters, no labels or text. The target is a simple achievable game-material visual, using clean flat-color hand-painted, pointed oval LEAF BLADES ONLY. Use only three closely related solid sage/grass green colors; each individual leaf has a single flat fill. No stems, branches, vines, tendrils, leaf veins, gradients within leaves, photorealistic texture, moss, ambient-occlusion blobs, photographic ivy, hanging grass, or tiny noisy leaf detail.
CRITICAL DISTRIBUTION: a dense, overlapping, almost continuous irregular canopy of leaves growing OVER THE TOP EDGE of the wall. Most of the first 10–15 percent of wall height is foliage-covered, with scalloped uneven lower boundary. From this canopy, four connected leaf-only cascades extend DOWNWARD different distances: one reaches about halfway down the wall left of centre, two are shorter around one quarter to one third of wall height, and one narrow tapering cascade at the right reaches about 40 percent of wall height. All descending groups visibly originate from the top canopy, made entirely of overlapping recognizable leaves, with no visible vine/stem. Cluster width and density progressively decrease with distance DOWN from the top. Leaf shapes remain natural pointed ovals, never stretched into horizontal slivers. Small gaps and a few edge leaves belong to the connected hanging groups; no isolated confetti scattered across the whole wall. The bottom 45 percent of wall must remain essentially empty ivory. This is a strong top-heavy composition with controlled downward density falloff, not uniform random scatter.
ARCHITECTURE: preserve broad calm wall surfaces. Only one or two very subtle long horizontal construction seams and one widely spaced vertical joint, creating very LARGE panels, not ceramic tiles. No grid midlines or dashed lines. A clean stylized near-future abandoned-garden game art direction, bright diffuse lighting, restrained shallow shadow, clear individual leaf silhouettes. Do not turn the leaf masses into solid rectangular green patches; make their overlapping leaf outlines legible. Clean professional material study with the entire wall visible.
flat_style_revision_prompt: Use case: style-transfer / precise-object-edit. Edit the supplied wall concept. Preserve the SINGLE WALL, exact front-on composition, the top-heavy connected foliage outline, the FOUR varying-length downward cascades, wide blank lower wall, large sparse construction seams, wall margins and camera. Change the rendering into a STRICT FLAT-COLOR GAME ART MATERIAL STUDY. Redraw every leaf as a clean simple pointed oval / almond silhouette, using exactly THREE solid green fills (#388e3c deep, #66bb6a mid, #81c784 light). Each leaf is one single uniform color from end to end. Flat colors with crisp smooth contour, overlapping simple leaves, like hand-painted paper cutouts. No veins, no central crease, no highlights, no mottling, no surface texture, no internal gradients, no leaf underside detail, no photorealistic shading. REMOVE EVERY visible stem, stalk, petiole, branch, vine or thin connecting line; groups are connected by overlapping LEAF BLADES ONLY. Keep leaves fairly wide natural ovals, never narrow squashed shapes. Remove hanging string-like tips: end each cascade with a few overlapping clearly visible leaf silhouettes. The ivy cast-shadow should be absent or extremely faint. The wall is a single clean uniform warm ivory fill with just the two existing very fine straight construction seams; remove realistic wall grunge, speckles and material texture. Background and floor use simple pale blue-gray / ivory solid fills, a tiny grounding shadow only. Overall looks like an achievable cel-shaded indie-game material prototype rendered straight-on, not a photograph or a detailed architectural visualization. Preserve the densely overlapping top 10–15 percent leaf canopy and decreasing density going downward, with four connected unequal cascades; lower 40 percent wall remains blank. No text, labels, people, extra buildings.
